title: fix(fields): submit a file or image upload as its sys_file id, or refuse it by name — never as the inline blob (objectui#7699)
body:
Fixes #7699
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What changed

`fileValueForSubmit` no longer falls back to the legacy inline `{ name, original_name, size, mime_type, url }` object when the upload adapter surfaces no `meta.fileId`. It returns the bare `sys_file` id, or throws the new named `UploadIncompleteError` (`name` `UploadIncompleteError`, `code` `UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE`, `fileName`). Every caller catches it per pick and renders the translated `fields.file.uploadIncomplete` row ("Upload of NAME did not complete: ..."), so the field is not changed and no blob reaches `onChange`. The `## Submitting` docblock in `file-value.ts` is rewritten with the code (triage `5853462220`, ADR-0104's 2026-09-05 addendum). Reading is unchanged: a legacy blob already on a record still renders.

Files: `packages/fields/src/widgets/{file-value.ts, FileField.tsx, ImageField.tsx}`, new `upload-error-message.ts` (the shared error row for the transport-failed and the incomplete case, module-internal), the new key in all ten `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` packs, tests, one changeset (`@object-ui/fields` + `@object-ui/i18n`: `patch`), and three docs pages whose value-shape sentences this change made false (`content/docs/fields/file.mdx`, `content/docs/fields/image.mdx`, `content/docs/core/enhanced-actions.mdx`). `UploadProvider.tsx` is untouched; no objectstack change.

## H1 census (the stop valve), measured on objectui `origin/main` and objectstack `origin/main`

| Adapter (`@object-ui/providers`) | what it returns | exported from the index | who mounts it in this repo | reachable in the console | what the ObjectStack backend does with its no-id value |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createObjectUrlAdapter()` | `{ url: blob:..., name, size, mimeType }`, no `meta` | yes | nobody explicitly: it is `useUpload()`'s fallback with no provider above, and `UploadProvider`'s default when no `adapter` prop is passed. Reached today by bare embeddings and by the docs-site live demos (`apps/site` mounts no provider) | no: `App` mounts `UploadProvider` with the ObjectStack adapter above `ConsoleShell`, so route elements and the sibling dialogs of `GlobalActionRuntimeProvider` are all below it (objectui#10131; pinned by `App.uploadAltitude-10131.test.tsx`) | the bytes are stored nowhere (a tab-local `blob:` URL). The value is refused `invalid_type` wherever media values are enforced; `App`'s own docblock records the `400 ... expected string, received object` measured under objectui#10131 |
| `createS3Adapter(opts)` | `{ url: publicUrl, name, size, mimeType }`, no `meta` | yes | nobody (zero call sites outside `UploadProvider.tsx`; control: the ObjectStack adapter's two mount sites are found by the same grep) | no | no `sys_file` row is minted, so no id exists. Refused as above on enforcing deployments; see the enforcement row below |
| `createAzureBlobAdapter(opts)` | `{ url: publicUrl, name, size, mimeType }`, no `meta` | yes | nobody (same grep) | no | same as S3 |
| `createObjectStackUploadAdapter(opts)` | `meta: { fileId, scope }`; throws `Presigned upload response missing uploadUrl/fileId` when the presign answer has no id (an error arm) | yes | `App` (console root) and `RecordAttachmentsPanel` (calls the adapter directly, not through `fileValueForSubmit`) | yes, the only one | the id is stored |
| a host's own `UploadAdapter` | whatever it returns | n/a | n/a | n/a | one that surfaces no `meta.fileId` falls into the rows above |

**Enforcement, objectstack `origin/main`.** `validateRecord`'s media arm rejects a value outside `FileReferenceIdValueSchema` with `invalid_type` when `mediaStrictEffective` answers true: `OS_DATA_VALUE_SHAPE_STRICT_ENABLED=1`, or the deployment's `adr-0104-file-references` flag is recorded. The flag is written by `os migrate files-to-references --apply` and, at creation, for every datastore born empty (`attestFreshDatastore`). Only an un-migrated deployment admits the blob, warn-first, with the validator's own line "accepted for now (ADR-0104 warn-first; run `os migrate files-to-references --apply` ...)". On such a deployment each admitted blob is a blocking finding: the reconciliation refuses to record the flag over it, and the addendum's column move aborts on any cell that is not a JSON string. So the blob keeps that deployment off the ruled end-state.

**Verdict: (a) proceed.** Every no-`fileId` path is either an error arm (the ObjectStack adapter's missing-id throw), or produces a value the backend refuses (every creation-attested or migrated deployment) or is ruled to refuse (the stored contract has been id-only since spec `17.0.0`, and the 2026-09-05 addendum puts the column on the bare id; warn-first admission is the un-migrated transition's leniency, not a supported write). S3 and Azure mint no `sys_file` row, so they cannot produce a record-field value under that contract. For them the client refusal is the same outcome as before, earlier and named. They stay usable where a URL is the value, such as the avatar and logo flows that read `result.url` directly.

Not adapter paths, and so outside this card: `ProfilePage` (avatar) and the organization `SettingsPage` (logo) take `result.url` into auth/org props, not record fields; the `file-upload` component in `@object-ui/components` calls no adapter at all (it emits `File[]`).

## H2, per site

- `fileValueForSubmit`: bare id, or `throw new UploadIncompleteError(originalName ?? result.name)`. A thrown named error rather than a `{ error }` return, because all three callers already surface upload failures from a per-pick `catch`. Throwing inside the existing `try` lands the refusal in that same arm with no new control flow.
- `FileField` / `FileCell` (`useFileUploads`, shared by both): `fileValueForSubmit` moved inside the per-pick `try`. A refused pick is reported and dropped, and the other picks of the same batch still land.
- `ImageField`, native picker: the same move. `remember` (the preview cache) now runs after the id check, so nothing is cached for a refused pick.
- `ImageField`, crop confirm: the same. The original image stays and the dialog closes, so the row shows below the field, not behind the dialog.
- The message: `uploadErrorMessage` picks `fields.file.uploadIncomplete` for an `UploadIncompleteError` and `fields.file.uploadFailed` for anything else. It replaces `ImageField`'s private `uploadFailedMessage` and `FileField`'s inline copy, so the two widgets cannot drift apart.
- `uploadResultView` is left alone. It is read-side and only feeds `recent`, which is keyed by id and filled only when an id exists.
- `withRecentUploads` cannot carry a blob into a submit. A merged view keeps `raw` as the stored value item, and removal builds the next value from the value array, never from views.

## H3, signature

`packages/fields/src/index.tsx` re-exports the module wholesale (`export * from './widgets/file-value.js'`). So `fileValueForSubmit` is public, and its return type narrows from `string` OR a `Record` of STRING to UNKNOWN (generics spelled in words here because GitHub strips angle-bracket shapes) to plain `string`. It now throws where it used to return an object. `UploadIncompleteError` is a new public export through the same line. `uploadErrorMessage` is not exported. Built declaration: see Gates. No caller outside `@object-ui/fields` (a repo-wide grep finds only `FileField.tsx` and `ImageField.tsx`), so no cross-package consumer's types move.

⇒ `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`: the public surface widens by one export, and a public function narrows. ⚠️ The claim comment `5855823570` declares `Clause-②: no` and says the seat re-rules if the export is public. It is public, so the seat owns that re-rule. Changeset level stays `patch` as ordered.

## H4, legacy values

- Render: `readFileValue` / `readFileValues` are unchanged. The unit controls `reads the legacy inline blob (snake_case mime_type)` and `handles a mixed-form array during the transition` still pass. Both widgets render a legacy blob (file by its name, image by its `src`), pinned as the read control in `fileSubmitRequiresId-7699.test.tsx`.
- `multiple` with a legacy blob plus a new upload: the widget sends `[LEGACY_BLOB, id]`, where the first element is the SAME object it received, asserted by identity (`toBe`) in both widgets. That is the stored value passed back untouched, not a new write of that shape.

## Pins and ablations

Pins: the unit pin on `fileValueForSubmit` (`file-value.test.ts`); the widget pins through the REAL `FileField`, `FileCell` and `ImageField` (picker AND crop) under a real `UploadProvider` with a spy adapter (`fileSubmitRequiresId-7699.test.tsx`); and the console's no-provider counter-probe, which now pins the refusal (`App.uploadAltitude-10131.test.tsx`). Each refusal arm also asserts the adapter WAS called once, so "onChange never fired" cannot pass on a widget that never uploads, and that no `onChange` argument carries `url` or `mime_type`.

Three legs over those three files, all under the verify lock and read with `--reporter=verbose`:

| leg | tree | result |
|---|---|---|
| H, green on head | `431869d912` (the pin files are unchanged since) | 3 files, **59 passed / 59** |
| A, red on base | `file-value.ts`, `FileField.tsx`, `ImageField.tsx` checked out at base `805abe240c` (each disk blob == the base blob; markers: blob branch 1, `UploadIncompleteError` 0), tests at head | **10 failed / 49 passed** |
| B, ablation | only the blob branch of `fileValueForSubmit` put back, via `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, marker 0 → 1, blob `f815a0af89d1` → `623f01bacdc5`); callers at head | **10 failed / 49 passed** |

The 10 red in A and B are the same 10, the refusal arms: FileField (single, multiple, no-provider), FileCell, ImageField picker and crop, the three unit refusal pins, and the console counter-probe. The standalone fileId arms and the legacy-read controls stay green in every leg, as controls should. The FileCell test holds both arms in one test, so it is counted once, among the red. Both restores are proven: `git diff HEAD` is empty on the three paths, each disk blob equals its HEAD blob, and the ablation marker count is 0 afterwards. (Leg A no longer bleeds into the neighbouring console test the way an earlier run did: the `URL` stub is undone in `afterEach` now.)

## Gates

Tests at `00f7d580c3`, under the verify lock: `vitest run packages/fields/` plus the upload tests of the packages that import the widgets (`App.uploadAltitude-10131`, `FormPage.fileField`, `ActionParamDialog.uploading`, `ActionParamDialog`, `paramValueShape`, `WizardForm.nextMidUpload`, `uploadInFlightSave`): **221 files, 220 passed, 1 skipped; 3568 tests passed, 7 skipped**. From there to the final head `497ec995bb` exactly two test files changed (`git diff --stat`). Both were re-run at `497ec995bb` with `packages/i18n/` and the pin files: **74 files, 1237 passed**.

- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/fields` (the package plus its `^build` closure): 11/11 tasks. The built `dist/widgets/file-value.d.ts` declares `fileValueForSubmit(result: UploadResultLike, originalName?: string): string` and `class UploadIncompleteError extends Error`. The old record-typed union appears 0 times after it.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` exit 0. It runs `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` against the built `.d.ts`, and `--listFiles` holds each of the five edited or added fields test files once. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` exit 0 at `497ec995bb`.
- `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` pins the de pack's paired-quote census. The new key adds one `„{{name}}“` span, so both counts move by one matched pair, with `rdq` still 0. That census failing at `431869d912` (66 found, 65 pinned) is what caught it.
- Gates, exit 0 at the final head: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (1 key added, 0 en values changed), `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-links`, `check-changeset-presence` (1 changeset for 3 released packages), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:changeset-claims` (report-only: it names 3 pending changesets that cite `enhanced-actions.mdx` or `en.ts`, all read, none falsified), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:esm-specifiers`.
- NOT MEASURED, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 2): `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` need a 34-package scoped build, and `check:eager-locale-catalogues` needs a built console. CI owns them. The only fenced code this branch edits is the `file.mdx` block, which renames one `const` and its comment; its import is unchanged.
- Lint: eslint over the 21 edited TS/TSX files at `497ec995bb` gives 0 errors and 39 warnings (36 `no-explicit-any`, 2 `react-hooks/preserve-manual-memoization`, 1 `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`), and the diff adds no inline disables. This is a targeted run, not a proven narrowing. The per-package `turbo run lint` is CI's.

## Serial

`git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD` against a fresh `origin/main` (origin/main `17b323e5ca`, head `497ec995bb`): clean. No file this branch touches moved on `main` since the base `805abe240c`, so no merge commit.

## Acceptance notes

- **Docs-site demos.** `apps/site` mounts no `UploadProvider`, so a pick in the live file/image demos (`fields-file/*`, `fields-image/*`) now shows the "did not complete" row where it used to show a `blob:` preview. The old preview was a success that stored nothing. A demo adapter that mints a demo id would restore the preview; that is a separate choice (no carrier).
- `UploadedFileMetadata`'s docblock in `@object-ui/types` still reads "as carried in a file/image field's VALUE". That is still true of legacy values, so it is not made false here. Noted, not touched.
- Surface beyond the claim's list, each forced by the fix: `upload-error-message.ts` (the shared row); the ten locale packs (the refusal is translated, like the widgets' other upload errors); `apps/console/src/__tests__/App.uploadAltitude-10131.test.tsx`, whose counter-probe pinned the retired blob on the wire and now pins the refusal; `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`, the de census the new key moves by one span; and the three docs pages above.
- The widget pins match the refusal's ruled name (`Upload of "NAME" did not complete`), not its full translatable sentence.
